## AS IS — Current state

### Not applicable in this repository

No public HTTP APIs, REST endpoints, GraphQL interfaces, gRPC definitions, or webhook listeners exist in this repository. As an Android launcher application, all inter-component and external communication occurs through Android OS framework mechanisms, including Intent actions, LauncherApps callbacks, BroadcastReceiver subscriptions, and system service APIs.
